name: Old Greytooth

source.note: A side quest boss of our own (The Hunters at the Inn, docs/story/side_quests.md), built from the 2025 Monster Manual's dire wolf: its bite, Pack Tactics and senses, scaled to a Huge wolf of CR 8 with legendary actions.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.summary: Advantage on attack rolls against a target that has a non-Incapacitated ally of this creature within 5 ft.
traits.text: Old Greytooth has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature when at least one of its allies is within 5 feet of that creature and that ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.summary: Twice a day, a failed saving throw becomes a success.
traits.text: When Old Greytooth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead, twice a day.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Old Greytooth makes two Bite attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.summary: Bites a target within 10 ft; a Large or smaller target is knocked Prone.
actions.text: Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it has the Prone condition.

actions.name: Howl of the Castle Hills
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6: everyone but beasts within 30 ft makes a DC 15 Wis save or is Frightened until its next turn.
actions.text: Each creature within 30 feet of Old Greytooth that isn't a Beast makes a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. Failure: the target has the Frightened condition until the start of Old Greytooth's next turn.

summary: A wolf the size of a horse, grey to the roots of its teeth, that the castle keeps for its own hunts: bites that knock you down, a howl that empties your nerve, and one more bite whenever you think you've stepped clear.
